projects.title: 365 Days, 365 AQI Levels

projects.title: Specimen001

projects.alt: Specimen001 — a bejeweled cow beside a preserved glass of milk

projects.title: Buried in the Crowd
projects.description: Mapping the interconnected forces behind crowd disasters in India, from systemic failures to possible points of change.
projects.alt: Buried in the Crowd — original systems-thinking project artwork

projects.title: Taarghar
projects.description: A group installation recreating a telegraph office — my part turns sign-language gestures into Morse code and a printed telegram.
projects.alt: Taarghar — The Telegraph Office, multisensory installation

projects.title: Antisocial Glasses
projects.description: A wearable experiment in personal space: sensing proximity and sound, without interpreting speech.
projects.alt: Antisocial Glasses prototype on a mannequin

projects.title: Remnant
projects.description: A video poem exploring memory, time, and the fragments of everyday life that shape who we become.
projects.alt: Remnant — video poem still, clock hands and hourglass

projects.title: Thela, Thaila, Thikana
projects.description: A research-driven project on street vendors, space, and informal systems in Ahmedabad's municipal market.

projects.title: Mautam — The Famine
projects.description: VR simulation exploring the bamboo masting famine of 19th-century Mizoram, built in Unity and Blender.
projects.alt: Mautam — sunlit bamboo forest canopy from below

projects.title: AlignR
projects.description: A wearable posture corrector exploring gentle, real-time feedback for everyday posture.
projects.alt: AlignR — front view, side view and upper-back placement

bio:
I’m Tripti, growing up in Delhi made me curious about people, public spaces, and the stories unfolding around me every day. Design became a way for me to explore those questions and better understand the world around me.
        I’m especially interested in new media and immersive experiences. I work across interfaces, 3D environments, physical computing, and print, exploring how different mediums shape the way an experience is felt.
        Outside of design, you’ll usually find me reading, watching films, or cooking. They keep me grounded and continually introduce me to new perspectives and ways of thinking. By day I’m a designer, and by night I am…
